concept.zh: 争分 · 跨桥转运与截收
concept.en: Score race · Bridge transfers and interception

brief.zh: 十一件货横跨两岸。第一次涨水只封桥、第二次放水只开桥、第三次轮换桥口；每次还会转运一件滞留货。24 回合内与 3 台对手争夺电池，每块 1 分。电池收完或时间到时，必须独占最高分。同格同时拾取时按计分板顺序轮换优先权，第 1 回合芽芽优先。 第 5, 11, 17 回合结束时切换通道并转移未取的货物；占用的门当次保持开启。从容模式须用同一程序通过两张地图。 控制台的 A、B 调度表列出两局地形、货物、机器人起点和调闸坐标。
brief.en: Eleven loads span the banks. The first flood closes a crossing, the drain opens a crossing, and the third tide swaps crossings. Each tide also transfers one unclaimed load. Race 3 rivals over 24 turns. Each battery is worth one point. Be the sole leader when the batteries run out or time expires. Simultaneous claims rotate in scoreboard order, starting with Sprout on turn one. After turns 5, 11, 17, gates change and unclaimed cargo is transferred. Occupied gates stay open for that shift. In Relaxed mode, win both maps with the same program. The A and B schedule cards include both maps, cargo, rival starts and gate coordinates.
